result.description: A fictional 34-inch curved ultrawide display designed for immersive productivity and casual entertainment. It features a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 144Hz refresh rate, USB-C single-cable connectivity, and integrated KVM switching for clean multi-device desk setups. The understated matte chassis and 1900R curvature are intended for creators, analysts, and home-office users who want wide workspace without gaming-focused styling. Built-in speakers, HDR10 support, and a height-adjustable stand round out the feature set.
